scope: Formula menu and garage UX/UI revision

observedIssues.issue: Two large navigation rows and bright white/pink cards compete with the car
observedIssues.change: One home hub, compact garage tabs, dark red rounded panels, white typography and restrained yellow focus

observedIssues.issue: Changing an upgrade level silently cycles the value
observedIssues.change: Explicit owned-level selection with current state and no credit charge

observedIssues.issue: Hover/selection and equip are conflated in livery cards
observedIssues.change: Preview is reversible; separate equip/buy action shows ownership, cost and lock reason

observedIssues.issue: Locked career cards cannot be inspected
observedIssues.change: Allow details; disable race launch until progression criteria pass

observedIssues.issue: Refreshing or closing a modal jumps focus to the first control
observedIssues.change: Remember focus per page/subsection and restore modal origin

observedIssues.issue: Visual composition has no consistent transition or focus response
observedIssues.change: Short unscaled page reveal, animated yellow focus outline and fixed footer hints

observedIssues.issue: New UI appeared only in Play Mode; old Canvas remained in scenes and audio opened its old panel
observedIssues.change: Serialize the complete new UI as a connected prefab, remove legacy scene canvases, use persistent screen/card components, and replace audio/controls with new serialized views

acceptanceCriteria: Inspect locked event without launching or spending
Preview a livery without changing saved equipped livery
Explicit equip and purchase retain chassis upgrades
Choose base and owned engine levels without spending
Modal cancel returns focus to its source
Virtual gamepad supports section switching, submit and cancel
Readable 1280x720 UI with all actionable controls inside canvas
Visually compare requested screens against Figma; no grayscale menu states
New menu visible in Edit Mode and immediately on scene load
Exactly one active initial screen and one Canvas per menu scene
Audio settings and interactive rebind use the new UI and existing save fields
status: Authored hierarchy and current UX/UI verified in Edit Mode and Play Mode: 13 menu + 6 garage checks passed

validation.gamepad: Input System virtual gamepad; shoulder, submit, cancel and focus restoration
